# harborpilot_gateway_token (Ephemeral Resource)

Issues a short-lived gateway token for a client binding while Terraform runs and revokes it afterwards. Requires Terraform 1.10 or later. Use it to pass a token to another provider or a write-only argument without storing it in state.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Issue a short-lived token for one run and hand it to a write-only
# argument; it is revoked when Terraform finishes.
ephemeral "harborpilot_gateway_token" "relay" {
  binding_id  = harborpilot_client_binding.relay.id
  name        = "relay"
  ttl_seconds = 900
}

resource "harborpilot_notification_channel" "relay" {
  name = "relay-webhook"
  spec = jsonencode({
    type        = "webhook"
    webhook_url = "https://relay.example.com/notify"
    enabled     = true
  })
  secrets_wo         = { secret = ephemeral.harborpilot_gateway_token.relay.token }
  secrets_wo_version = 1
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `binding_id` (String) Client binding id.

### Optional

- `bound_refs` (Map of String) Trusted external references bound to the token.
- `name` (String) Label (default `terraform-ephemeral`).
- `scopes` (Set of String) Scopes. Default: `gateway:invoke`, `gateway:models`.
- `ttl_seconds` (Number) Lifetime in seconds (default 3600, at most 86400). The token is also revoked when Terraform closes it.

### Read-Only

- `base_urls` (Map of String)
- `credential_id` (String)
- `expires_at` (String)
- `prefix` (String)
- `token` (String, Sensitive) The bearer token.
